title: Implementation Plan
summary: A concise, reviewable path from the current state to a dependable release.
progressCaption: Calculated from completed tasks in this plan.

phases.name: Frame the work
phases.summary: Confirm the outcome, constraints, and evidence of success.

tasks.title: Document the current state
tasks.detail: Capture relevant behavior, interfaces, and ownership.

tasks.title: Agree on acceptance criteria
tasks.detail: Make each criterion observable and testable.

phases.name: Build the smallest complete slice
phases.summary: Implement the core path without adding speculative surface area.

phases.name: Verify and release
phases.summary: Test the result in realistic conditions and prepare a reversible rollout.

architecture.label: Implementation
architecture.detail: The smallest change set that satisfies the agreed outcome.

architecture.label: Verification
architecture.detail: Automated checks, rendered review, and release evidence.

decisions.title: Prefer incremental delivery
decisions.decision: Ship one end-to-end slice before broadening scope.
decisions.rationale: It reveals integration risk earlier and keeps review concrete.

decisions.title: Keep deployment reversible
decisions.decision: Use versioned releases and preserve a known-good rollback target.
decisions.rationale: A release should not turn uncertainty into an outage.

risks.title: Hidden compatibility assumptions
risks.description: Existing consumers may rely on behavior that is not documented.
risks.mitigation: Inspect current callers and add characterization tests before changing interfaces.

risks.title: Scope expansion
risks.description: Adjacent improvements could delay the core outcome.
risks.mitigation: Track optional ideas separately and require an explicit scope decision.
